description.zh: 记忆片段内容。长度为 1~200 个字符，支持中文、英文、数字、下划线（_）、短划线（-）、半角句号（.）和半角冒号（:）。
description.en: The content of the memory node. The content must be 1 to 200 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), hyphens (-), periods (.), and colons (:).

description.zh: 长期记忆体 ID。即 **CreateMemory** 接口返回的`memoryId`。
description.en: The long-term memory ID, which is the memoryId returned by the **CreateMemory** operation.

description.zh: 长期记忆体所属的业务空间 ID。获取方式请参见[如何使用业务空间](~~2587495~~)。
description.en: The ID of the workspace to which the long-term memory belongs. For information about how to obtain the workspace ID, see [How to use workspaces](~~2587495~~).
